title: ""
page-layout: custom
toc: false

```{=html}
<div class="exploration-section">

  <!-- =========================================================================
       VIEW 1: WORLD MAP VIEW
       ========================================================================= -->
  <div id="world-view" class="exploration-view is-active">
    <!-- Header -->
    <div class="exploration-header">
      <div class="hero-eyebrow">Interactive Motoring Atlas</div>
      <h1 class="exploration-title">Different countries made different cars.</h1>
      <p class="exploration-subtitle">
        Explore production histories, manufacturers, and classic specimens by country.
      </p>
    </div>

    <!-- Map Stage Wrapper -->
    <div class="map-wrapper">
      <div class="map-topbar">
        <div id="selected-indicator" class="map-selected-readout">
          <span class="map-status-pill"></span>
          <span class="selected-label">Selected:</span>
          <span class="selected-highlight" id="selected-country-name">None</span>
        </div>
        <div class="map-hints">Select a country to view its cars</div>
      </div>

      <div class="map-stage" id="map-container">
        <div id="map-tooltip" class="map-tooltip"></div>
        <svg id="world-map-svg" class="map-svg" viewBox="0 0 960 500" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"></svg>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>


  <!-- =========================================================================
       VIEW 2: COUNTRY-SPECIFIC VIEW
       ========================================================================= -->
  <div id="country-view" class="exploration-view is-hidden">
    <!-- Country Navigation Bar -->
    <div class="country-nav-bar">
      <button id="btn-back-nav" class="btn-back-world">
        <span class="back-arrow">&larr;</span> <span id="back-nav-label">Return to atlas</span>
      </button>

      <div id="country-breadcrumbs" class="country-breadcrumbs">
        <span id="crumb-world" class="breadcrumb-item">Atlas</span>
        <span class="breadcrumb-sep">/</span>
        <span id="crumb-country" class="breadcrumb-item is-current">Country</span>
        <span id="crumb-mfg-sep" class="breadcrumb-sep" style="display:none;">/</span>
        <span id="crumb-mfg" class="breadcrumb-item is-current" style="display:none;">Automaker</span>
        <span id="crumb-year-sep" class="breadcrumb-sep" style="display:none;">/</span>
        <span id="crumb-year" class="breadcrumb-item is-current" style="display:none;">Year</span>
        <span id="crumb-car-sep" class="breadcrumb-sep" style="display:none;">/</span>
        <span id="crumb-car" class="breadcrumb-item is-current" style="display:none;">Vehicle</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Country Identity Hero -->
    <div class="country-view-hero">
      <div class="country-identity-row">
        <div class="country-flag-frame">
          <img id="country-flag-img" src="" alt="National Flag" />
          <span id="country-flag-fallback" class="country-flag-fallback" style="display: none;"></span>
        </div>
        <div class="country-heading-group">
          <h1 id="country-view-name" class="country-view-title">Country</h1>
          <div class="country-view-subtitle">Selected territory</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Subtle Map Locator Indication -->
      <div class="country-locator-card">
        <div class="country-locator-info">
          <span class="locator-label">Atlas Location</span>
          <span id="locator-detail-text" class="locator-detail">Selected nation highlighted on the map</span>
        </div>
        <div class="country-locator-stage">
          <svg id="locator-svg" class="locator-svg" viewBox="0 0 240 110" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"></svg>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Country Automotive Content Area -->
    <div class="country-content-space">

      <!-- STAGE A: AUTOMAKERS LIST -->
      <div id="automakers-panel" class="exploration-panel is-active">
        <!-- National Chronology Invite Card -->
        <div id="country-timeline-invite-box" class="country-timeline-invite">
          <div class="timeline-invite-info">
            <span class="invite-eyebrow">Chronological Overview</span>
            <h3 id="timeline-invite-title" class="invite-title">Explore Production Across Time</h3>
            <p id="timeline-invite-desc" class="invite-desc">Trace the evolution of all vehicles recorded for this country.</p>
          </div>
          <button id="btn-explore-timeline" class="btn-explore-timeline">
            <span>Explore Timeline</span> &rarr;
          </button>
        </div>

        <div class="section-head">
          <div class="section-eyebrow">National Manufacturers</div>
          <h2 class="section-title">Manufacturers</h2>
          <p id="automakers-subtitle" class="section-desc">
            Select a marque to view models in the archive.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div id="automakers-grid-container" class="automakers-grid">
          <!-- Populated dynamically -->
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- STAGE B: SPECIMEN VEHICLES & YEAR / TIMELINE EXPLORATION -->
      <div id="models-panel" class="exploration-panel is-hidden">
        <div class="models-header-row">
          <div class="section-head" style="margin-bottom:0;">
            <div id="models-eyebrow" class="section-eyebrow">Manufacturer Archive</div>
            <h2 id="models-title" class="section-title">Models</h2>
            <p id="models-desc" class="section-desc">
              Specimens represented in the historical automotive collection.
            </p>
          </div>
          <div id="models-scope-container" style="display:none;">
            <button id="btn-scope-all-country" class="btn-scope-switch">View all national cars</button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- HISTORICAL AUTOMOTIVE TIMELINE CONTROL (PROMPT 4) -->
        <div id="timeline-control-block" class="timeline-control-block">
          <div class="timeline-meta-bar">
            <div class="timeline-year-readout">
              <span class="timeline-eyebrow">Historical Era</span>
              <div class="timeline-year-heading">
                <span id="timeline-active-year-display" class="timeline-active-year">All Years</span>
                <span id="timeline-year-status" class="timeline-year-status">Displaying all archive models</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="timeline-nav-group">
              <button id="btn-timeline-all" class="btn-timeline-toggle is-active" title="View all recorded years">All Eras</button>
              <div class="timeline-stepper">
                <button id="btn-timeline-prev" class="btn-timeline-step" title="Previous recorded year" aria-label="Previous year">&larr;</button>
                <button id="btn-timeline-next" class="btn-timeline-step" title="Next recorded year" aria-label="Next year">&rarr;</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Timeline Scrubber Track -->
          <div class="timeline-rail-scroller">
            <div class="timeline-rail-inner" id="timeline-rail-inner">
              <div id="timeline-decade-labels" class="timeline-decade-labels"></div>
              <div class="timeline-rail-axis"></div>
              <div id="timeline-year-nodes" class="timeline-year-nodes"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div id="models-grid-container" class="models-grid">
          <!-- Populated dynamically -->
        </div>

        <!-- STAGE C: AUTOMOTIVE DATA SPECIFICATIONS INSPECTOR (PROMPT 5) -->
        <div id="automotive-data-stage" class="automotive-data-stage is-hidden">
          <div class="spec-stage-header">
            <div class="spec-stage-heading">
              <span class="spec-eyebrow">The Car</span>
              <h3 id="spec-stage-title" class="spec-title">Technical Dossier</h3>
              <p id="spec-stage-subtitle" class="spec-subtitle">Authentic factory specifications from master automotive engineering records.</p>
            </div>
            <div id="spec-view-controls" class="spec-view-controls" style="display:none;">
              <button id="btn-view-dossier" class="spec-toggle-btn is-active" type="button" title="Inspect selected specimen">Specimen Dossier</button>
              <button id="btn-view-comparison" class="spec-toggle-btn" type="button" title="Compare visible specimens">Fleet Comparison</button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Quick specimen selector pills for switching among visible cars -->
          <div id="spec-car-switcher" class="spec-car-switcher" style="display:none;">
            <span class="spec-switcher-label">Inspect Vehicle:</span>
            <div id="spec-switcher-pills" class="spec-switcher-pills"></div>
          </div>

          <!-- Single Car Dossier View -->
          <div id="spec-single-dossier" class="spec-dossier-panel is-active">
            <div class="spec-hero-card">
              <div class="spec-hero-media">
                <img id="spec-hero-img" src="" alt="Vehicle specimen" class="spec-hero-img" />
              </div>
              <div class="spec-hero-info">
                <div class="spec-hero-badges">
                  <span id="spec-badge-year" class="spec-pill-badge">Year</span>
                  <span id="spec-badge-make" class="spec-pill-badge accent">Make</span>
                  <span id="spec-badge-category" class="spec-pill-badge">Category</span>
                </div>
                <h2 id="spec-hero-name" class="spec-hero-name">Car Name</h2>
                <div id="spec-hero-gen" class="spec-hero-gen">Generation</div>
                <p id="spec-hero-note" class="spec-hero-note"></p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Primary Performance Benchmarks -->
            <div id="spec-benchmarks-grid" class="spec-benchmarks-grid"></div>

            <!-- Powertrain & Mechanical Architecture -->
            <div id="spec-powertrain-block" class="spec-dossier-section">
              <h4 class="spec-section-heading">Powertrain &amp; Mechanical Architecture</h4>
              <div id="spec-powertrain-grid" class="spec-attributes-grid"></div>
            </div>

            <!-- Physical Architecture & Dimensions -->
            <div id="spec-dimensions-block" class="spec-dossier-section">
              <h4 class="spec-section-heading">Physical Architecture &amp; Dimensions</h4>
              <div id="spec-dimensions-grid" class="spec-dimensions-grid"></div>
              <div id="spec-stance-bars" class="spec-stance-bars"></div>
            </div>

            <!-- Notice when specs are not in archive -->
            <div id="spec-no-data-notice" class="spec-no-data-notice" style="display:none;">
              <p class="spec-notice-text">
                Detailed engineering specifications for this historical specimen were not recorded in the automotive archive.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Fleet Comparison View -->
          <div id="spec-comparison-panel" class="spec-comparison-panel is-hidden">
            <div class="spec-comparison-table-wrapper">
              <table class="spec-comparison-table" id="spec-comparison-table">
                <thead><tr><th>Vehicle Specimen</th><th>Horsepower</th><th>Curb Weight</th><th>Fuel Economy</th><th>Drivetrain</th><th>Dimensions</th></tr></thead>
                <tbody></tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- STAGE D: COUNTRY CONTEXT (STEP 6B) -->
        <div id="country-context-stage" class="country-context-stage is-hidden">
          <div class="context-stage-header">
            <div class="context-stage-heading">
              <span class="context-eyebrow">The Country</span>
              <h3 id="context-stage-title" class="context-title">The car in its context</h3>
              <p id="context-stage-lead" class="context-lead">
                The selected vehicle is shown alongside the wider country in <span id="context-active-year-label">1970</span>. These figures describe the conditions of its country and period, giving you a basis for comparison without implying that one caused the other.
              </p>
            </div>
            <div class="context-country-badge" id="context-country-badge">
              <span class="context-badge-nation" id="context-badge-nation">Country</span>
              <span class="context-badge-year" id="context-badge-year">Year</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="context-inquiry-box">
            <span class="context-inquiry-icon">&para;</span>
            <p class="context-inquiry-text" id="context-inquiry-text">
              <strong>Investigation prompt:</strong> Could shifts in purchasing power, urbanization, or space constraints help explain changes in vehicle size, weight, and displacement across eras?
            </p>
          </div>

          <!-- Four Context Indicators Grid -->
          <div class="context-indicators-grid" id="context-indicators-grid">
            <!-- 1. GDP Per Capita -->
            <div class="context-indicator-card" id="card-context-gdp">
              <div class="context-card-top">
                <span class="context-card-label">Economic Output</span>
                <span class="context-card-code">NY.GDP.PCAP.KD</span>
              </div>
              <h4 class="context-card-title">GDP Per Capita</h4>
              <div class="context-card-value-wrap">
                <div class="context-card-value" id="val-context-gdp">&mdash;</div>
                <div class="context-card-unit">Constant 2015 US$ per person</div>
              </div>
              <div class="context-sparkline-wrap">
                <div class="context-sparkline-svg" id="sparkline-context-gdp"></div>
                <div class="context-sparkline-meta">
                  <span id="meta-context-gdp-start">1970</span>
                  <span class="context-sparkline-caption">Historical Trend</span>
                  <span id="meta-context-gdp-end">2024</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <p class="context-card-desc">Real national economic output per resident, adjusted for inflation.</p>
            </div>

            <!-- 2. Population Density -->
            <div class="context-indicator-card" id="card-context-density">
              <div class="context-card-top">
                <span class="context-card-label">Spatial Constraints</span>
                <span class="context-card-code">EN.POP.DNST</span>
              </div>
              <h4 class="context-card-title">Population Density</h4>
              <div class="context-card-value-wrap">
                <div class="context-card-value" id="val-context-density">&mdash;</div>
                <div class="context-card-unit">People per km² of land</div>
              </div>
              <div class="context-sparkline-wrap">
                <div class="context-sparkline-svg" id="sparkline-context-density"></div>
                <div class="context-sparkline-meta">
                  <span id="meta-context-density-start">1970</span>
                  <span class="context-sparkline-caption">Historical Trend</span>
                  <span id="meta-context-density-end">2023</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <p class="context-card-desc">Indicates spatial concentration, road footprint constraints, and garage pressure.</p>
            </div>

            <!-- 3. Urbanization -->
            <div class="context-indicator-card" id="card-context-urban">
              <div class="context-card-top">
                <span class="context-card-label">Demographic Distribution</span>
                <span class="context-card-code">SP.URB.TOTL.IN.ZS</span>
              </div>
              <h4 class="context-card-title">Urbanization</h4>
              <div class="context-card-value-wrap">
                <div class="context-card-value" id="val-context-urban">&mdash;</div>
                <div class="context-card-unit">% living in urban areas</div>
              </div>
              <div class="context-sparkline-wrap">
                <div class="context-sparkline-svg" id="sparkline-context-urban"></div>
                <div class="context-sparkline-meta">
                  <span id="meta-context-urban-start">1970</span>
                  <span class="context-sparkline-caption">Historical Trend</span>
                  <span id="meta-context-urban-end">2024</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <p class="context-card-desc">Reflects daily driving patterns, city traffic, and transit proximity.</p>
            </div>

            <!-- 4. Passenger Cars Per 1,000 Inhabitants -->
            <div class="context-indicator-card" id="card-context-cars">
              <div class="context-card-top">
                <span class="context-card-label">Motorization Rate</span>
                <span class="context-card-code" id="code-context-cars">OECD / UNECE</span>
              </div>
              <h4 class="context-card-title">Passenger Car Ownership</h4>
              <div class="context-card-value-wrap">
                <div class="context-card-value" id="val-context-cars">&mdash;</div>
                <div class="context-card-unit">Cars per 1,000 inhabitants</div>
              </div>
              <div class="context-sparkline-wrap">
                <div class="context-sparkline-svg" id="sparkline-context-cars"></div>
                <div class="context-sparkline-meta">
                  <span id="meta-context-cars-start">1994</span>
                  <span class="context-sparkline-caption">Harmonized Scope</span>
                  <span id="meta-context-cars-end">2024</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <p class="context-card-desc" id="desc-context-cars">Measures personal car availability relative to total resident population.</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Compact Sources & Provenance Footer -->
          <div class="context-provenance-bar">
            <details class="context-provenance-details">
              <summary class="context-provenance-summary">Sources &amp; Methodology Information</summary>
              <div class="context-provenance-content">
                <div class="context-provenance-grid" id="context-provenance-grid"></div>
              </div>
            </details>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>

</div>

<!-- D3, TOPOJSON & DATA SOURCES -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/topojson-client@3"></script>
<script src="data/countries_110m.js"></script>
<script src="data/iso_countries.js"></script>
<script src="data/cars_metadata.js"></script>
<script src="data/car_specs.js"></script>
<script src="data/manufacturers_config.js"></script>
<script src="data/country_context.js"></script>

<script>
// Modular reusable state
window.selectedCountry = null;
window.selectedManufacturer = null;

(function initExploration() {
  const worldView = document.getElementById("world-view");
  const countryView = document.getElementById("country-view");
  const btnBackNav = document.getElementById("btn-back-nav");
  const backNavLabel = document.getElementById("back-nav-label");

  // Breadcrumbs
  const crumbWorld = document.getElementById("crumb-world");
  const crumbCountry = document.getElementById("crumb-country");
  const crumbMfgSep = document.getElementById("crumb-mfg-sep");
  const crumbMfg = document.getElementById("crumb-mfg");
  const crumbYearSep = document.getElementById("crumb-year-sep");
  const crumbYear = document.getElementById("crumb-year");
  const crumbCarSep = document.getElementById("crumb-car-sep");
  const crumbCar = document.getElementById("crumb-car");

  // Automotive Data stage elements (Prompt 5)
  const automotiveDataStage = document.getElementById("automotive-data-stage");
  const specViewControls = document.getElementById("spec-view-controls");
  const btnViewDossier = document.getElementById("btn-view-dossier");
  const btnViewComparison = document.getElementById("btn-view-comparison");
  const specCarSwitcher = document.getElementById("spec-car-switcher");
  const specSwitcherPills = document.getElementById("spec-switcher-pills");
  const specSingleDossier = document.getElementById("spec-single-dossier");
  const specComparisonPanel = document.getElementById("spec-comparison-panel");
  const specHeroImg = document.getElementById("spec-hero-img");
  const specBadgeYear = document.getElementById("spec-badge-year");
  const specBadgeMake = document.getElementById("spec-badge-make");
  const specBadgeCategory = document.getElementById("spec-badge-category");
  const specHeroName = document.getElementById("spec-hero-name");
  const specHeroGen = document.getElementById("spec-hero-gen");
  const specHeroNote = document.getElementById("spec-hero-note");
  const specBenchmarksGrid = document.getElementById("spec-benchmarks-grid");
  const specPowertrainBlock = document.getElementById("spec-powertrain-block");
  const specPowertrainGrid = document.getElementById("spec-powertrain-grid");
  const specDimensionsBlock = document.getElementById("spec-dimensions-block");
  const specDimensionsGrid = document.getElementById("spec-dimensions-grid");
  const specStanceBars = document.getElementById("spec-stance-bars");
  const specNoDataNotice = document.getElementById("spec-no-data-notice");
  const specComparisonTable = document.getElementById("spec-comparison-table");

  // Country context elements
  const countryContextStage = document.getElementById("country-context-stage");
  const contextActiveYearLabel = document.getElementById("context-active-year-label");
  const contextBadgeNation = document.getElementById("context-badge-nation");
  const contextBadgeYear = document.getElementById("context-badge-year");
  const contextProvenanceGrid = document.getElementById("context-provenance-grid");

  const contextIndicators = [
    {
      key: "gdp_per_capita_constant_2015_usd",
      valueId: "val-context-gdp",
      sparklineId: "sparkline-context-gdp",
      startId: "meta-context-gdp-start",
      endId: "meta-context-gdp-end",
      format: value => `$${Math.round(value).toLocaleString()}`
    },
    {
      key: "population_density_per_km2",
      valueId: "val-context-density",
      sparklineId: "sparkline-context-density",
      startId: "meta-context-density-start",
      endId: "meta-context-density-end",
      format: value => value.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })
    },
    {
      key: "urbanization_percent",
      valueId: "val-context-urban",
      sparklineId: "sparkline-context-urban",
      startId: "meta-context-urban-start",
      endId: "meta-context-urban-end",
      format: value => `${value.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })}%`
    },
    {
      key: "passenger_cars_per_1000",
      valueId: "val-context-cars",
      sparklineId: "sparkline-context-cars",
      startId: "meta-context-cars-start",
      endId: "meta-context-cars-end",
      format: value => value.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })
    }
  ];

  // Automotive data state tracking
  let activeSelectedCar = null;
  let currentSpecViewMode = "dossier"; // "dossier" | "comparison"
  let currentVisibleCars = [];

  // Panels
  const automakersPanel = document.getElementById("automakers-panel");
  const modelsPanel = document.getElementById("models-panel");
  const automakersSubtitle = document.getElementById("automakers-subtitle");
  const automakersGrid = document.getElementById("automakers-grid-container");

  // National chronology invite card
  const countryTimelineInviteBox = document.getElementById("country-timeline-invite-box");
  const timelineInviteTitle = document.getElementById("timeline-invite-title");
  const timelineInviteDesc = document.getElementById("timeline-invite-desc");
  const btnExploreTimeline = document.getElementById("btn-explore-timeline");

  // Models panel timeline controls
  const modelsScopeContainer = document.getElementById("models-scope-container");
  const btnScopeAllCountry = document.getElementById("btn-scope-all-country");
  const timelineControlBlock = document.getElementById("timeline-control-block");
  const timelineActiveYearDisplay = document.getElementById("timeline-active-year-display");
  const timelineYearStatus = document.getElementById("timeline-year-status");
  const btnTimelineAll = document.getElementById("btn-timeline-all");
  const btnTimelinePrev = document.getElementById("btn-timeline-prev");
  const btnTimelineNext = document.getElementById("btn-timeline-next");
  const timelineDecadeLabels = document.getElementById("timeline-decade-labels");
  const timelineYearNodes = document.getElementById("timeline-year-nodes");

  // Timeline state tracking
  let activeScopeType = "manufacturer"; // "country" | "manufacturer"
  let activeScopeCars = [];
  let activeScopeName = "";
  let activeTimelineYear = null; // null = all eras
  let availableScopeYears = [];
  let railMinYear = 1970;
  let railMaxYear = 2024;

  const modelsEyebrow = document.getElementById("models-eyebrow");
  const modelsTitle = document.getElementById("models-title");
  const modelsDesc = document.getElementById("models-desc");
  const modelsGrid = document.getElementById("models-grid-container");

  // World map and SVG
  const mapSvg = d3.select("#world-map-svg");
  const locatorSvg = d3.select("#locator-svg");
  const mapContainer = document.getElementById("map-container");
  const tooltip = document.getElementById("map-tooltip");
  const selectedNameEl = document.getElementById("selected-country-name");

  // Country view elements
  const countryNameEl = document.getElementById("country-view-name");
  const countryFlagImg = document.getElementById("country-flag-img");
  const countryFlagFallback = document.getElementById("country-flag-fallback");
  const locatorDetailText = document.getElementById("locator-detail-text");

  const width = 960;
  const height = 500;

  // View state tracking: "world" | "country" | "manufacturer"
  let currentNavigationLevel = "world";
  let activeCountryData = null;

  // Projection setups
  const projection = d3.geoEqualEarth();
  const pathGenerator = d3.geoPath().projection(projection);

  const locatorProjection = d3.geoEqualEarth();
  const locatorPathGenerator = d3.geoPath().projection(locatorProjection);

  const gBase = mapSvg.append("g").attr("class", "map-base-layer");
  const gCountries = mapSvg.append("g").attr("class", "map-countries-layer");
  const gConnectors = mapSvg.append("g").attr("class", "map-connectors-layer");
  const gLogos = mapSvg.append("g").attr("class", "map-logos-layer");

  let activeCountryPath = null;
  let locatorCountries = null;
  let currentHoverCountryId = null;
  let hoverHideTimeout = null;

  function getCountryInfo(d) {
    const isoMap = window.ISO_COUNTRIES || {};
    const id = d && d.id ? String(d.id) : "";
    const name = d && d.properties ? d.properties.name || "" : "";
    const numInt = id && !isNaN(parseInt(id, 10)) ? String(parseInt(id, 10)) : "";

    const match = isoMap[id] || 
                  (numInt ? isoMap[numInt] : null) || 
                  isoMap[name] || 
                  (name ? isoMap[name.toLowerCase()] : null) || 
                  null;

    if (match) {
      return {
        id: id || match.iso3,
        name: match.name || name,
        iso2: (match.iso2 || "").toLowerCase(),
        iso3: (match.iso3 || "").toUpperCase()
      };
    }

    return {
      id: id,
      name: name || "Unknown",
      iso2: "",
      iso3: ""
    };
  }

  function getFlagEmoji(countryCode) {
    if (!countryCode || countryCode.length !== 2) return "🌐";
    const codePoints = countryCode
      .toUpperCase()
      .split("")
      .map(char => 127397 + char.charCodeAt(0));
    return String.fromCodePoint(...codePoints);
  }

  function getCountryCars(countryObj) {
    if (!window.CARS_METADATA || !Array.isArray(window.CARS_METADATA)) return [];
    const targetName = (countryObj.name || "").toLowerCase().trim();
    const targetIso3 = (countryObj.iso3 || "").toUpperCase().trim();

    return window.CARS_METADATA.filter(car => {
      const yr = parseInt(car["Model year"], 10);
      if (isNaN(yr) || yr < 1970) return false;

      const carCountry = (car["Country of manufacturer"] || "").toLowerCase().trim();
      if (carCountry === targetName) return true;
      if (targetName.includes(carCountry) || carCountry.includes(targetName)) return true;
      if (targetIso3 === "USA" && (carCountry.includes("united states") || carCountry === "usa")) return true;
      if (targetIso3 === "GBR" && (carCountry.includes("united kingdom") || carCountry === "uk")) return true;
      if (targetIso3 === "KOR" && (carCountry.includes("korea") || carCountry === "south korea")) return true;
      return false;
    });
  }

  function renderTopology(worldData) {
    if (!worldData || !worldData.objects || !worldData.objects.countries) return;

    const countries = topojson.feature(worldData, worldData.objects.countries).features
      .filter(d => d.id !== "010");

    projection.fitExtent([[30, 20], [width - 30, height - 20]], {
      type: "FeatureCollection",
      features: countries
    });

    locatorProjection.fitExtent([[6, 6], [234, 104]], {
      type: "FeatureCollection",
      features: countries
    });

    const graticule = d3.geoGraticule10();
    gBase.append("path")
      .datum(graticule)
      .attr("class", "map-graticule")
      .attr("d", pathGenerator);

    gCountries.selectAll("path.world-country")
      .data(countries)
      .enter()
      .append("path")
      .attr("class", d => {
        const country = getCountryInfo(d);
        const cars = getCountryCars(country);
        return cars.length > 0 ? "world-country has-data" : "world-country is-muted";
      })
      .attr("d", pathGenerator)
      .attr("data-id", d => d.id)
      .on("mouseenter", function(event, d) {
        const country = getCountryInfo(d);
        const cars = getCountryCars(country);
        if (cars.length > 0) {
          clearTimeout(hoverHideTimeout);
          tooltip.innerHTML = `
            <span class="tooltip-name">${country.name}</span>
            ${country.iso3 ? `<span class="tooltip-iso">${country.iso3}</span>` : ""}
            <span style="color:var(--text-muted);margin-left:0.35rem;font-size:0.75rem;">• ${cars.length} specimen${cars.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}</span>
          `;
          tooltip.style.opacity = "1";
          positionTooltip(event);
          showCountryLogos(d, country, cars);
        } else {
          tooltip.innerHTML = `
            <span class="tooltip-name">${country.name}</span>
            <span style="color:var(--text-muted);margin-left:0.35rem;font-size:0.75rem;">• No vehicle data</span>
          `;
          tooltip.style.opacity = "0.75";
          positionTooltip(event);
          scheduleHideLogos(180);
        }
      })
      .on("mousemove", function(event) {
        positionTooltip(event);
      })
      .on("mouseleave", function() {
        tooltip.style.opacity = "0";
        scheduleHideLogos(450);
      })
      .on("click", function(event, d) {
        const country = getCountryInfo(d);
        const cars = getCountryCars(country);
        if (cars.length > 0) {
          selectCountry(d, this);
        }
      });

    locatorCountries = locatorSvg.selectAll("path.locator-country")
      .data(countries)
      .enter()
      .append("path")
      .attr("class", "locator-country")
      .attr("d", locatorPathGenerator)
      .attr("data-id", d => d.id);
  }

  function scheduleHideLogos(delay = 450) {
    clearTimeout(hoverHideTimeout);
    hoverHideTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      hideCountryLogos();
    }, delay);
  }

  function hideCountryLogos() {
    currentHoverCountryId = null;
    gCountries.selectAll("path.world-country").classed("is-active-source", false);
    gConnectors.selectAll("circle.mfg-cluster-aura").remove();

    gConnectors.selectAll("line")
      .transition().duration(180)
      .style("opacity", 0)
      .remove();

    gLogos.selectAll("g.mfg-logo-node")
      .transition().duration(200)
      .style("opacity", 0)
      .remove();
  }

  function calculateLogoPositions(cx, cy, N, iso3) {
    const leftMargin = 48;
    const rightMargin = 48;
    const topMargin = 48;
    const bottomMargin = 48;

    const clampX = x => Math.max(leftMargin, Math.min(width - rightMargin, x));
    const clampY = y => Math.max(topMargin, Math.min(height - bottomMargin, y));

    const positions = [];

    if (N === 1) {
      const angle = -Math.PI * 0.25;
      const r = 66;
      positions.push({ x: clampX(cx + r * Math.cos(angle)), y: clampY(cy + r * Math.sin(angle)) });
      return positions;
    }

    if (N <= 9) {
      // Dynamic single ring: radius automatically scales to guarantee generous spacing (>=72px)
      const minSpacing = 72;
      const targetR = Math.max(76, minSpacing / (2 * Math.sin(Math.PI / N)));

      // Keep the cluster center within canvas margins so northern countries don't flatten against the top
      const effCy = Math.max(topMargin + targetR, Math.min(height - bottomMargin - targetR, cy));
      const effCx = Math.max(leftMargin + targetR, Math.min(width - rightMargin - targetR, cx));

      for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        const angle = (2 * Math.PI * i / N) - Math.PI / 2 + 0.12;
        positions.push({
          x: clampX(effCx + targetR * Math.cos(angle)),
          y: clampY(effCy + targetR * Math.sin(angle))
        });
      }
    } else {
      // 10+ manufacturers (e.g. USA with 16): Two concentric rings with staggered angles
      const innerCount = Math.floor(N * 0.38);
      const outerCount = N - innerCount;

      const rInner = Math.max(72, 70 / (2 * Math.sin(Math.PI / innerCount)));
      const rOuter = Math.max(rInner + 66, 72 / (2 * Math.sin(Math.PI / outerCount)));

      const effCy = Math.max(topMargin + rOuter, Math.min(height - bottomMargin - rOuter, cy));
      const effCx = Math.max(leftMargin + rOuter, Math.min(width - rightMargin - rOuter, cx));

      for (let i = 0; i < innerCount; i++) {
        const angle = (2 * Math.PI * i / innerCount) - Math.PI / 2;
        positions.push({
          x: clampX(effCx + rInner * Math.cos(angle)),
          y: clampY(effCy + rInner * Math.sin(angle))
        });
      }

      for (let j = 0; j < outerCount; j++) {
        const angle = (2 * Math.PI * j / outerCount) - Math.PI / 2 + (Math.PI / outerCount);
        positions.push({
          x: clampX(effCx + rOuter * Math.cos(angle)),
          y: clampY(effCy + rOuter * Math.sin(angle))
        });
      }
    }

    // Safety relaxation pass: iteratively resolves any remaining collision to guarantee >=64px center distance
    const MIN_SAFE_DIST = 64; // Badge circle diameter is 52px; 64px provides a 12px clear buffer
    for (let iter = 0; iter < 20; iter++) {
      let collided = false;
      for (let i = 0; i < positions.length; i++) {
        for (let j = i + 1; j < positions.length; j++) {
          const dx = positions[j].x - positions[i].x;
          const dy = positions[j].y - positions[i].y;
          const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
          if (d < MIN_SAFE_DIST) {
            collided = true;
            const overlap = (MIN_SAFE_DIST - (d || 0.1)) / 2;
            const nx = ((dx || 0.1) / (d || 0.1)) * overlap;
            const ny = ((dy || 0.1) / (d || 0.1)) * overlap;
            positions[i].x -= nx;
            positions[i].y -= ny;
            positions[j].x += nx;
            positions[j].y += ny;
          }
        }
      }
      positions.forEach(p => {
        p.x = clampX(p.x);
        p.y = clampY(p.y);
      });
      if (!collided) break;
    }

    return positions;
  }

  function showCountryLogos(d, country, cars) {
    if (currentHoverCountryId === d.id) {
      return;
    }
    currentHoverCountryId = d.id;

    // Highlight source country
    gCountries.selectAll("path.world-country")
      .classed("is-active-source", feat => feat.id === d.id);

    // Group cars by manufacturer
    const groups = {};
    cars.forEach(car => {
      const m = car["Manufacturer"] || "Unknown";
      if (!groups[m]) groups[m] = [];
      groups[m].push(car);
    });

    const mfgNames = Object.keys(groups).sort((a, b) => groups[b].length - groups[a].length || a.localeCompare(b));
    const logosMap = window.MANUFACTURER_LOGOS || {};

    const mfgItems = mfgNames.map(mfgName => {
      const normKey = mfgName.toLowerCase();
      const id = normKey.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/^-|-$/g, "");
      const logo = (logosMap[normKey] !== undefined) ? logosMap[normKey] : (logosMap[id] !== undefined ? logosMap[id] : null);
      const mfgCars = groups[mfgName];
      const years = mfgCars.map(c => parseInt(c["Model year"], 10)).filter(y => !isNaN(y));
      const minYear = years.length ? Math.min(...years) : null;
      const maxYear = years.length ? Math.max(...years) : null;
      const eraStr = minYear && maxYear ? (minYear === maxYear ? `${minYear}` : `${minYear} — ${maxYear}`) : "Archive";

      return {
        id: id,
        name: mfgName,
        logo: logo,
        count: mfgCars.length,
        cars: mfgCars,
        minYear: minYear,
        maxYear: maxYear,
        eraStr: eraStr
      };
    });

    // Anchor coordinates for geographic precision
    const COUNTRY_COORDS = {
      "USA": [-98.5, 39.5],
      "JPN": [138.2, 36.2],
      "DEU": [10.4, 51.1],
      "GBR": [-2.2, 54.5],
      "ITA": [12.5, 42.5],
      "FRA": [2.2, 46.6],
      "SWE": [16.5, 62.0],
      "KOR": [127.7, 36.5]
    };

    let center;
    if (country.iso3 && COUNTRY_COORDS[country.iso3]) {
      center = projection(COUNTRY_COORDS[country.iso3]);
    } else {
      center = pathGenerator.centroid(d);
    }

    const cx = center[0];
    const cy = center[1];
    const positions = calculateLogoPositions(cx, cy, mfgItems.length, country.iso3);

    // Continuous interactive aura behind cluster to prevent premature closes
    const maxDist = Math.max(...positions.map(p => Math.hypot(p.x - cx, p.y - cy)), 60);
    let aura = gConnectors.selectAll("circle.mfg-cluster-aura").data([1]);
    aura.enter()
      .insert("circle", ":first-child")
      .attr("class", "mfg-cluster-aura")
      .merge(aura)
      .attr("cx", cx)
      .attr("cy", cy)
      .attr("r", maxDist + 44)
      .on("mouseenter", function() {
        clearTimeout(hoverHideTimeout);
      })
      .on("mouseleave", function() {
        scheduleHideLogos(450);
      });

    // 1. Connector lines
    const connectorData = mfgItems.map((item, i) => ({
      id: item.id,
      x1: cx,
      y1: cy,
      x2: positions[i].x,
      y2: positions[i].y
    }));

    const lines = gConnectors.selectAll("line")
      .data(connectorData, item => item.id);

    lines.exit()
      .transition().duration(160)
      .style("opacity", 0)
      .remove();

    const linesEnter = lines.enter()
      .append("line")
      .attr("x1", cx)
      .attr("y1", cy)
      .attr("x2", cx)
      .attr("y2", cy)
      .style("opacity", 0)
      .on("mouseenter", function() {
        clearTimeout(hoverHideTimeout);
      });

    linesEnter.merge(lines)
      .transition()
      .duration(260)
      .delay((item, i) => i * 20)
      .ease(d3.easeCubicOut)
      .attr("x1", cx)
      .attr("y1", cy)
      .attr("x2", item => item.x2)
      .attr("y2", item => item.y2)
      .style("opacity", 1);

    // 2. Logo badge nodes
    const nodeData = mfgItems.map((item, i) => ({
      ...item,
      x: positions[i].x,
      y: positions[i].y,
      cx: cx,
      cy: cy
    }));

    const nodes = gLogos.selectAll("g.mfg-logo-node")
      .data(nodeData, item => item.id);

    nodes.exit()
      .transition().duration(160)
      .style("opacity", 0)
      .remove();

    const nodesEnter = nodes.enter()
      .append("g")
      .attr("class", "mfg-logo-node")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${cx}, ${cy})`)
      .style("opacity", 0);

    // Generous invisible hit target circle (diameter 64px) for effortless clicking
    nodesEnter.append("circle")
      .attr("class", "mfg-hit-area")
      .attr("r", 32);

    // Badge plate group (stable in place - no scaling transforms)
    const badge = nodesEnter.append("g").attr("class", "mfg-logo-badge");

    // Visible badge circle (diameter 52px, ~1.8x original visual area)
    badge.append("circle")
      .attr("class", "mfg-badge-circle")
      .attr("r", 26);

    // Image (36x36px) or Monogram fallback
    badge.each(function(mfg) {
      const g = d3.select(this);
      if (mfg.logo) {
        g.append("image")
          .attr("class", "mfg-badge-image")
          .attr("href", mfg.logo)
          .attr("x", -18)
          .attr("y", -18)
          .attr("width", 36)
          .attr("height", 36)
          .attr("preserveAspectRatio", "xMidYMid meet");
      } else {
        const initials = mfg.name.split(" ").map(w => w[0]).join("").substring(0, 3).toUpperCase();
        g.append("text")
          .attr("class", "mfg-badge-monogram")
          .attr("y", 5)
          .text(initials);
      }
    });

    // Floating editorial label neatly above badge
    const label = nodesEnter.append("g")
      .attr("class", "mfg-logo-label")
      .attr("transform", "translate(0, -36)");

    label.append("rect")
      .attr("class", "mfg-label-rect")
      .attr("x", -52)
      .attr("y", -13)
      .attr("width", 104)
      .attr("height", 26)
      .attr("rx", 3);

    label.append("text")
      .attr("class", "mfg-label-text")
      .attr("y", -1)
      .text(item => item.name.toUpperCase());

    label.append("text")
      .attr("class", "mfg-label-count")
      .attr("y", 9)
      .text(item => `${item.count} ${item.count === 1 ? 'vehicle' : 'vehicles'}`);

    // Events on logo nodes
    nodesEnter
      .on("mouseenter", function(event, item) {
        clearTimeout(hoverHideTimeout);
        gLogos.selectAll("g.mfg-logo-node")
          .classed("is-dimmed", d => d.id !== item.id)
          .classed("is-hovered", d => d.id === item.id);
        gConnectors.selectAll("line")
          .classed("is-highlighted", d => d.id === item.id)
          .classed("is-dimmed", d => d.id !== item.id);
        if (selectedNameEl) {
          selectedNameEl.innerHTML = `${country.name} • <strong>${item.name}</strong> (${item.count} ${item.count === 1 ? 'model' : 'models'})`;
        }
      })
      .on("mouseleave", function(event, item) {
        gLogos.selectAll("g.mfg-logo-node").classed("is-dimmed", false).classed("is-hovered", false);
        gConnectors.selectAll("line").classed("is-highlighted", false).classed("is-dimmed", false);
        if (selectedNameEl) {
          selectedNameEl.innerHTML = `${country.name} ${country.iso3 ? `<span class="selected-iso">(${country.iso3})</span>` : ""} • ${cars.length} specimen${cars.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
        }
        scheduleHideLogos(450);
      })
      .on("click", function(event, item) {
        event.stopPropagation();
        selectCountry(d, null, item);
      });

    // Smooth entrance animation - locks into stable (x, y) coordinates with ZERO jitter
    nodesEnter.merge(nodes)
      .transition()
      .duration(280)
      .delay((item, i) => i * 20)
      .ease(d3.easeCubicOut)
      .attr("transform", item => `translate(${item.x}, ${item.y})`)
      .style("opacity", 1);
  }

  function selectCountry(d, element, targetMfg) {
    const country = getCountryInfo(d);
    activeCountryData = country;
    activeSelectedCar = null;
    updateCountryContext();
    hideCountryLogos();

    // Highlight on main map
    if (activeCountryPath) {
      activeCountryPath.classed("is-selected", false);
    }
    if (element) {
      activeCountryPath = d3.select(element);
      activeCountryPath.classed("is-selected", true);
    } else {
      activeCountryPath = gCountries.select(`path[data-id="${d.id}"]`);
      activeCountryPath.classed("is-selected", true);
    }

    // Highlight on locator map
    if (locatorCountries) {
      locatorCountries.classed("is-target", f => f.id === d.id);
    }

    // Store state in window.selectedCountry
    window.selectedCountry = {
      id: d.id,
      name: country.name,
      iso2: country.iso2,
      iso3: country.iso3
    };
    window.selectedManufacturer = targetMfg || null;

    // Update main map indicator bar
    if (selectedNameEl) {
      selectedNameEl.innerHTML = `${country.name} ${country.iso3 ? `<span class="selected-iso">(${country.iso3})</span>` : ""}`;
    }

    // Populate country identity
    countryNameEl.textContent = country.name;
    locatorDetailText.textContent = `${country.name} ${country.iso3 ? `(${country.iso3})` : ""} active territory`;

    // Flag setup
    if (country.iso2) {
      countryFlagImg.style.display = "block";
      countryFlagFallback.style.display = "none";
      countryFlagImg.src = `https://flagcdn.com/${country.iso2}.svg`;
      countryFlagImg.alt = `${country.name} Flag`;

      countryFlagImg.onerror = function() {
        this.style.display = "none";
        countryFlagFallback.textContent = getFlagEmoji(country.iso2);
        countryFlagFallback.style.display = "inline-block";
      };
    } else {
      countryFlagImg.style.display = "none";
      countryFlagFallback.textContent = "🌐";
      countryFlagFallback.style.display = "inline-block";
    }

    // Always build Automakers section from data so back-navigation works
    populateAutomakers(country);

    if (targetMfg) {
      // Transition directly to manufacturer specimen models
      currentNavigationLevel = "manufacturer";
      backNavLabel.textContent = `Return to ${country.name}`;
      crumbCountry.textContent = country.name;
      crumbCountry.classList.remove("is-current");
      crumbMfgSep.style.display = "inline";
      crumbMfg.style.display = "inline";
      crumbMfg.textContent = targetMfg.name;

      automakersPanel.classList.remove("is-active");
      automakersPanel.classList.add("is-hidden");
      modelsPanel.classList.remove("is-hidden");
      modelsPanel.classList.add("is-active");

      populateManufacturerModels(targetMfg);

      worldView.style.opacity = "0";
      setTimeout(() => {
        worldView.classList.remove("is-active");
        worldView.classList.add("is-hidden");

        countryView.classList.remove("is-hidden");
        countryView.classList.add("is-active");
        countryView.style.opacity = "0";
        document.querySelector(".country-content-space").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });

        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          countryView.style.opacity = "1";
        });
      }, 200);

      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("manufacturerSelected", { detail: targetMfg }));
    } else {
      // Standard country view showing all automakers
      currentNavigationLevel = "country";
      backNavLabel.textContent = "Return to atlas";
      crumbCountry.textContent = country.name;
      crumbCountry.classList.add("is-current");
      crumbMfgSep.style.display = "none";
      crumbMfg.style.display = "none";

      automakersPanel.classList.remove("is-hidden");
      automakersPanel.classList.add("is-active");
      modelsPanel.classList.remove("is-active");
      modelsPanel.classList.add("is-hidden");

      worldView.style.opacity = "0";
      setTimeout(() => {
        worldView.classList.remove("is-active");
        worldView.classList.add("is-hidden");

        countryView.classList.remove("is-hidden");
        countryView.classList.add("is-active");
        countryView.style.opacity = "0";
        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });

        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          countryView.style.opacity = "1";
        });
      }, 200);

      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("countrySelected", { detail: window.selectedCountry }));
    }
  }

  function populateAutomakers(country) {
    const cars = getCountryCars(country);
    automakersGrid.innerHTML = "";

    if (cars.length === 0) {
      if (countryTimelineInviteBox) countryTimelineInviteBox.style.display = "none";
      automakersSubtitle.textContent = "No automotive data recorded for this territory.";
      automakersGrid.innerHTML = `
        <div class="automakers-empty-card" style="grid-column: 1 / -1;">
          <div class="empty-icon">📁</div>
          <h3 class="empty-title">No vehicle records in archive</h3>
          <p class="empty-desc">
            There are no automotive manufacturers or specimen models recorded for <strong>${country.name}</strong> in the current project archive.
          </p>
          <button id="btn-empty-return" class="btn-back-world">
            <span class="back-arrow">&larr;</span> Return to Atlas
          </button>
        </div>
      `;
      const btnEmpty = document.getElementById("btn-empty-return");
      if (btnEmpty) btnEmpty.addEventListener("click", backToWorld);
      return;
    }

    // Configure National Chronology invite card
    const allCountryYears = cars.map(c => parseInt(c["Model year"], 10)).filter(y => !isNaN(y));
    if (countryTimelineInviteBox) {
      if (allCountryYears.length > 0) {
        const minYr = Math.min(...allCountryYears);
        const maxYr = Math.max(...allCountryYears);
        const eraStr = minYr === maxYr ? `${minYr}` : `${minYr} — ${maxYr}`;
        countryTimelineInviteBox.style.display = "flex";
        if (timelineInviteTitle) timelineInviteTitle.textContent = `Explore ${country.name}'s Automotive History Across Time`;
        if (timelineInviteDesc) timelineInviteDesc.textContent = `Chronological record of all ${cars.length} specimen${cars.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} across production years (${eraStr}).`;
      } else {
        countryTimelineInviteBox.style.display = "none";
      }
    }

    // Group cars by Manufacturer
    const groups = {};
    cars.forEach(car => {
      const mfg = car["Manufacturer"] || "Unknown";
      if (!groups[mfg]) {
        groups[mfg] = [];
      }
      groups[mfg].push(car);
    });

    const mfgNames = Object.keys(groups).sort((a, b) => groups[b].length - groups[a].length || a.localeCompare(b));
    automakersSubtitle.textContent = `${mfgNames.length} distinct automaker${mfgNames.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} recorded with ${cars.length} specimen models in the archive.`;
    const logosMap = window.MANUFACTURER_LOGOS || {};

    mfgNames.forEach(mfgName => {
      const mfgCars = groups[mfgName];
      const years = mfgCars.map(c => parseInt(c["Model year"], 10)).filter(y => !isNaN(y));
      const minYear = years.length ? Math.min(...years) : null;
      const maxYear = years.length ? Math.max(...years) : null;
      const eraStr = minYear && maxYear ? (minYear === maxYear ? `${minYear}` : `${minYear} — ${maxYear}`) : "Archive";
      const monogram = mfgName.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase();

      const normKey = mfgName.toLowerCase();
      const id = normKey.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/^-|-$/g, "");
      const logo = (logosMap[normKey] !== undefined) ? logosMap[normKey] : (logosMap[id] !== undefined ? logosMap[id] : null);

      const card = document.createElement("div");
      card.className = "automaker-card";
      card.innerHTML = `
        <div>
          <div class="automaker-card-top">
            ${logo ? `<div class="mfg-logo-frame"><img src="${logo}" alt="${mfgName}" class="mfg-logo-img" /></div>` : `<div class="mfg-monogram">${monogram}</div>`}
            <div class="mfg-badge-count">${mfgCars.length} ${mfgCars.length === 1 ? 'Model' : 'Models'}</div>
          </div>
          <h3 class="mfg-title">${mfgName}</h3>
          <p class="mfg-era">${eraStr}</p>
        </div>
        <div class="automaker-card-bottom">
          <span class="mfg-action-text">View models</span>
          <span class="mfg-chevron">&rarr;</span>
        </div>
      `;

      card.addEventListener("click", function() {
        selectManufacturer({
          name: mfgName,
          id: id,
          logo: logo,
          cars: mfgCars,
          count: mfgCars.length,
          minYear: minYear,
          maxYear: maxYear,
          eraStr: eraStr
        });
      });

      automakersGrid.appendChild(card);
    });
  }

  function exploreCountryTimeline(country) {
    activeScopeType = "country";
    activeScopeCars = getCountryCars(country);
    activeScopeName = country.name;
    activeManufacturerData = null;
    window.selectedManufacturer = null;
    currentNavigationLevel = "manufacturer";

    backNavLabel.textContent = `Return to ${country.name}`;
    crumbCountry.textContent = country.name;
    crumbCountry.classList.remove("is-current");
    crumbMfgSep.style.display = "inline";
    crumbMfg.style.display = "inline";
    crumbMfg.textContent = "Chronology";
    if (crumbYearSep) crumbYearSep.style.display = "none";
    if (crumbYear) crumbYear.style.display = "none";
    if (crumbCarSep) crumbCarSep.style.display = "none";
    if (crumbCar) crumbCar.style.display = "none";

    if (modelsScopeContainer) {
      modelsScopeContainer.style.display = "none";
    }

    const allYears = activeScopeCars.map(c => parseInt(c["Model year"], 10)).filter(y => !isNaN(y));
    const minYr = allYears.length ? Math.min(...allYears) : "";
    const maxYr = allYears.length ? Math.max(...allYears) : "";
    const eraStr = minYr && maxYr ? (minYr === maxYr ? `${minYr}` : `${minYr} — ${maxYr}`) : "Archive";

    modelsEyebrow.textContent = `${country.name} • National Chronology`;
    modelsTitle.textContent = "Production Timeline";
    modelsDesc.textContent = `All ${activeScopeCars.length} specimens from ${country.name} arranged across chronological production eras (${eraStr}).`;

    setupTimeline(activeScopeCars, country.name);

    automakersPanel.style.opacity = "0";
    setTimeout(() => {
      automakersPanel.classList.remove("is-active");
      automakersPanel.classList.add("is-hidden");

      modelsPanel.classList.remove("is-hidden");
      modelsPanel.classList.add("is-active");
      modelsPanel.style.opacity = "0";

      document.querySelector(".country-content-space").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });

      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        modelsPanel.style.opacity = "1";
      });
    }, 180);
  }

  function populateManufacturerModels(mfg) {
    activeScopeType = "manufacturer";
    activeScopeCars = mfg.cars;
    activeScopeName = mfg.name;
    activeManufacturerData = mfg;

    if (modelsScopeContainer) {
      modelsScopeContainer.style.display = "block";
      btnScopeAllCountry.textContent = `View all ${activeCountryData ? activeCountryData.name : 'national'} cars`;
    }

    modelsEyebrow.textContent = `${activeCountryData ? activeCountryData.name : 'Atlas'} • Specimen Collection`;
    modelsTitle.textContent = mfg.name;
    modelsDesc.textContent = `${mfg.count} specimen ${mfg.count === 1 ? 'model' : 'models'} across production eras (${mfg.eraStr}).`;

    setupTimeline(mfg.cars, mfg.name);
  }

  function setupTimeline(scopeCars, scopeName, defaultYear = null) {
    activeScopeCars = scopeCars;
    activeScopeName = scopeName;

    availableScopeYears = [...new Set(
      scopeCars.map(c => parseInt(c["Model year"], 10)).filter(y => !isNaN(y) && y >= 1970)
    )].sort((a, b) => a - b);

    if (availableScopeYears.length === 0) {
      if (timelineControlBlock) timelineControlBlock.style.display = "none";
      renderCarsGrid([], null, scopeName, []);
      return;
    }

    if (timelineControlBlock) timelineControlBlock.style.display = "block";

    // The year timeline begins strictly at 1970 and continues through latest dataset year (2024)
    railMinYear = 1970;
    railMaxYear = 2024;

    // Decade markers (1970 to present)
    if (timelineDecadeLabels) {
      timelineDecadeLabels.innerHTML = "";
      const decades = [1970, 1980, 1990, 2000, 2010, 2020];
      decades.forEach(dec => {
        const pct = ((dec - railMinYear) / (railMaxYear - railMinYear)) * 100;
        const marker = document.createElement("div");
        marker.className = "timeline-decade-marker";
        marker.style.left = `${pct}%`;
        marker.innerHTML = `
          <span class="timeline-decade-text">${dec}</span>
          <div class="timeline-decade-tick"></div>
        `;
        timelineDecadeLabels.appendChild(marker);
      });
    }

    // Year nodes / pips
    if (timelineYearNodes) {
      timelineYearNodes.innerHTML = "";
      availableScopeYears.forEach(y => {
        const pct = ((y - railMinYear) / (railMaxYear - railMinYear)) * 100;
        const count = scopeCars.filter(c => parseInt(c["Model year"], 10) === y).length;
        const pip = document.createElement("button");
        pip.type = "button";
        pip.className = "timeline-year-pip";
        pip.dataset.year = y;
        pip.style.left = `${pct}%`;
        pip.title = `${y} • ${count} specimen${count === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
        pip.innerHTML = `
          <span class="pip-dot"></span>
          <span class="pip-label">${y}</span>
        `;
        pip.addEventListener("click", () => {
          selectTimelineYear(y);
        });
        timelineYearNodes.appendChild(pip);
      });
    }

    selectTimelineYear(defaultYear);
  }

  function selectTimelineYear(year) {
    activeTimelineYear = year !== null && !isNaN(parseInt(year, 10)) ? parseInt(year, 10) : null;

    // Breadcrumb year
    if (crumbYearSep && crumbYear) {
      if (activeTimelineYear === null) {
        crumbYearSep.style.display = "none";
        crumbYear.style.display = "none";
      } else {
        crumbYearSep.style.display = "inline";
        crumbYear.style.display = "inline";
        crumbYear.textContent = activeTimelineYear;
      }
    }

    // "All Eras" toggle
    if (btnTimelineAll) {
      btnTimelineAll.classList.toggle("is-active", activeTimelineYear === null);
    }

    // Year pips active state
    if (timelineYearNodes) {
      timelineYearNodes.querySelectorAll(".timeline-year-pip").forEach(pip => {
        const pipYr = parseInt(pip.dataset.year, 10);
        pip.classList.toggle("is-active", activeTimelineYear !== null && pipYr === activeTimelineYear);
      });
    }

    // Stepper states
    if (btnTimelinePrev && btnTimelineNext) {
      if (availableScopeYears.length > 0) {
        if (activeTimelineYear === null) {
          btnTimelinePrev.disabled = false;
          btnTimelineNext.disabled = false;
          btnTimelinePrev.title = `Jump to earliest recorded year (${availableScopeYears[0]})`;
          btnTimelineNext.title = `Jump to latest recorded year (${availableScopeYears[availableScopeYears.length - 1]})`;
        } else {
          const idx = availableScopeYears.indexOf(activeTimelineYear);
          btnTimelinePrev.disabled = (idx <= 0);
          btnTimelineNext.disabled = (idx >= availableScopeYears.length - 1 || idx === -1);
          if (idx > 0) {
            btnTimelinePrev.title = `Previous: ${availableScopeYears[idx - 1]}`;
          } else {
            btnTimelinePrev.title = "At earliest recorded year";
          }
          if (idx < availableScopeYears.length - 1 && idx !== -1) {
            btnTimelineNext.title = `Next: ${availableScopeYears[idx + 1]}`;
          } else {
            btnTimelineNext.title = "At latest recorded year";
          }
        }
      } else {
        btnTimelinePrev.disabled = true;
        btnTimelineNext.disabled = true;
      }
    }

    // Readout headline
    if (activeTimelineYear === null) {
      if (timelineActiveYearDisplay) timelineActiveYearDisplay.textContent = "All Eras";
      const minYear = availableScopeYears.length > 0 ? availableScopeYears[0] : "";
      const maxYear = availableScopeYears.length > 0 ? availableScopeYears[availableScopeYears.length - 1] : "";
      const range = minYear === maxYear ? minYear : `${minYear} — ${maxYear}`;
      if (timelineYearStatus) {
        timelineYearStatus.textContent = `${activeScopeCars.length} specimen${activeScopeCars.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} across archive (${range})`;
      }
      renderCarsGrid(activeScopeCars, null, activeScopeName, availableScopeYears);
    } else {
      if (timelineActiveYearDisplay) timelineActiveYearDisplay.textContent = activeTimelineYear;
      const matching = activeScopeCars.filter(c => parseInt(c["Model year"], 10) === activeTimelineYear);
      if (timelineYearStatus) {
        if (matching.length > 0) {
          timelineYearStatus.textContent = `${matching.length} specimen${matching.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} recorded in ${activeScopeName} for ${activeTimelineYear}`;
        } else {
          timelineYearStatus.textContent = `No specimens recorded for ${activeTimelineYear}`;
        }
      }
      renderCarsGrid(matching, activeTimelineYear, activeScopeName, availableScopeYears);
    }

    updateCountryContext();
  }

  function renderContextSparkline(container, records, indicator, selectedYear) {
    container.innerHTML = "";
    const points = records
      .filter(record => record[indicator.key] !== null && record[indicator.key] !== undefined)
      .map(record => ({ year: record.year, value: record[indicator.key] }));

    if (points.length < 2) return;

    const width = 240;
    const height = 32;
    const x = d3.scaleLinear()
      .domain(d3.extent(points, point => point.year))
      .range([1, width - 1]);
    const y = d3.scaleLinear()
      .domain(d3.extent(points, point => point.value))
      .nice()
      .range([height - 3, 3]);
    const svg = d3.select(container)
      .append("svg")
      .attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${width} ${height}`)
      .attr("preserveAspectRatio", "none")
      .attr("role", "img")
      .attr("aria-label", `${indicator.key} historical trend`);
    const line = d3.line()
      .x(point => x(point.year))
      .y(point => y(point.value));

    svg.append("path")
      .datum(points)
      .attr("class", "context-sparkline-line")
      .attr("d", line);

    const selectedPoint = points.find(point => point.year === selectedYear);
    if (selectedPoint) {
      svg.append("circle")
        .attr("class", "context-sparkline-point")
        .attr("cx", x(selectedPoint.year))
        .attr("cy", y(selectedPoint.value))
        .attr("r", 2.5);
    }

    document.getElementById(indicator.startId).textContent = points[0].year;
    document.getElementById(indicator.endId).textContent = points[points.length - 1].year;
  }

  function renderContextSources() {
    if (!contextProvenanceGrid || !window.COUNTRY_CONTEXT_METADATA) return;
    const variables = window.COUNTRY_CONTEXT_METADATA.variables || {};
    contextProvenanceGrid.innerHTML = contextIndicators.map(indicator => {
      const metadata = variables[indicator.key] || {};
      const sourceUrl = metadata.source_url ? ` <a href="${metadata.source_url.split(" /")[0]}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Source</a>.` : "";
      return `<div class="context-provenance-item"><strong>${metadata.name || indicator.key}</strong>: ${metadata.source_agency || "Source not specified"} (indicator <code>${metadata.indicator_code || "not specified"}</code>). ${metadata.coverage_years || "Coverage not specified"}.<br><em>${metadata.notes || ""}</em>${sourceUrl}</div>`;
    }).join("");
  }

  function updateCountryContext() {
    if (!countryContextStage || !activeCountryData || !activeSelectedCar || !Array.isArray(window.COUNTRY_CONTEXT)) {
      if (countryContextStage) {
        countryContextStage.classList.remove("is-active");
        countryContextStage.classList.add("is-hidden");
      }
      return;
    }

    const iso3 = (activeCountryData.iso3 || "").toUpperCase();
    const selectedYear = activeTimelineYear || parseInt(activeSelectedCar["Model year"], 10);
    const countryRecords = window.COUNTRY_CONTEXT.filter(record => record.iso3 === iso3);
    const record = countryRecords.find(item => item.year === selectedYear);

    if (!iso3 || !record || !selectedYear) {
      countryContextStage.classList.remove("is-active");
      countryContextStage.classList.add("is-hidden");
      return;
    }

    countryContextStage.classList.remove("is-hidden");
    countryContextStage.classList.add("is-active");
    contextActiveYearLabel.textContent = selectedYear;
    contextBadgeNation.textContent = record.country;
    contextBadgeYear.textContent = selectedYear;

    contextIndicators.forEach(indicator => {
      const valueElement = document.getElementById(indicator.valueId);
      const value = record[indicator.key];
      valueElement.classList.toggle("is-unavailable", value === null || value === undefined);
      valueElement.textContent = value === null || value === undefined
        ? "Data unavailable for this year"
        : indicator.format(value);
      renderContextSparkline(document.getElementById(indicator.sparklineId), countryRecords, indicator, selectedYear);
    });

    renderContextSources();
  }

  function getCarSpecs(car) {
    if (!car) return null;
    const carName = car["Car name"];
    if (window.CAR_SPECS && window.CAR_SPECS[carName]) {
      return window.CAR_SPECS[carName];
    }
    return car.specs || null;
  }

  function selectCar(car, visibleCars = null) {
    if (!car) return;
    activeSelectedCar = car;
    if (visibleCars) {
      currentVisibleCars = visibleCars;
    } else if (currentVisibleCars.length === 0) {
      currentVisibleCars = [car];
    }

    // Update active state on car cards in models grid
    if (modelsGrid) {
      modelsGrid.querySelectorAll(".car-model-card").forEach(card => {
        const isTarget = card.dataset.carName === car["Car name"];
        card.classList.toggle("is-selected", isTarget);
      });
    }

    // Update breadcrumbs
    if (crumbCarSep && crumbCar) {
      crumbCarSep.style.display = "inline";
      crumbCar.style.display = "inline";
      crumbCar.textContent = car["Car name"];
      crumbCar.classList.add("is-current");
      if (crumbYear) crumbYear.classList.remove("is-current");
      if (crumbMfg) crumbMfg.classList.remove("is-current");
      if (crumbCountry) crumbCountry.classList.remove("is-current");
    }

    // Reveal Automotive Data stage
    if (automotiveDataStage) {
      automotiveDataStage.classList.remove("is-hidden");
      automotiveDataStage.classList.add("is-active");
    }

    // Quick switcher pills & comparison controls
    const showMultiControls = currentVisibleCars.length >= 2;
    if (specViewControls) {
      specViewControls.style.display = showMultiControls ? "inline-flex" : "none";
    }
    if (specCarSwitcher) {
      specCarSwitcher.style.display = showMultiControls ? "flex" : "none";
      if (showMultiControls && specSwitcherPills) {
        specSwitcherPills.innerHTML = "";
        currentVisibleCars.forEach(c => {
          const pill = document.createElement("button");
          pill.type = "button";
          pill.className = `spec-switcher-pill ${c["Car name"] === car["Car name"] ? "is-active" : ""}`;
          pill.textContent = `${c["Model year"]} ${c["Car name"].replace(/^\d{4}\s+/, "")}`;
          pill.addEventListener("click", () => {
            selectCar(c, currentVisibleCars);
          });
          specSwitcherPills.appendChild(pill);
        });
      }
    }

    renderSpecDossier(car);
    if (currentSpecViewMode === "comparison") {
      renderSpecComparison(currentVisibleCars, car);
    }
    updateCountryContext();
  }

  function renderSpecDossier(car) {
    if (!car) return;
    const specs = getCarSpecs(car) || {};

    // Hero metadata
    if (specHeroImg) {
      specHeroImg.src = car["Image filename"] || "";
      specHeroImg.alt = car["Car name"] || "Vehicle specimen";
    }
    if (specBadgeYear) specBadgeYear.textContent = car["Model year"] || "";
    if (specBadgeMake) specBadgeMake.textContent = car["Manufacturer"] || activeScopeName;
    if (specBadgeCategory) specBadgeCategory.textContent = car["Vehicle category"] || "Specimen";
    if (specHeroName) specHeroName.textContent = car["Car name"] || "Specimen";
    if (specHeroGen) specHeroGen.textContent = car["Exact model generation"] || "";
    if (specHeroNote) {
      const src = car["Image source"] || "Automotive Archive";
      specHeroNote.textContent = `Archived engineering specimen • Source: ${src}`;
    }

    const hasAnySpecs = (
      specs.horsepower || specs.weight_kg || specs.mpg ||
      specs.engine || specs.drivetrain || specs.body_type ||
      specs.length_mm || specs.width_mm || specs.height_mm || specs.wheelbase_mm
    );

    if (specNoDataNotice) specNoDataNotice.style.display = hasAnySpecs ? "none" : "block";

    // 1. Performance Benchmarks Grid (Horsepower, Weight, MPG)
    if (specBenchmarksGrid) {
      specBenchmarksGrid.innerHTML = "";

      const benchmarkDefinitions = [
        { label: "Power Output", key: "horsepower", unit: "BHP / HP", note: "Mechanical horsepower at crank", scale: 750 },
        { label: "Curb Weight", key: "weight_kg", unit: "kg", note: specs.weight_lbs ? `${specs.weight_lbs.toLocaleString()} lbs unladen` : "Unladen weight", scale: 2600, accent: "gold" },
        { label: "Combined Economy", key: "mpg", unit: "US MPG", note: specs.fuel_economy_l100 ? `${specs.fuel_economy_l100} L/100km combined` : "Combined rating", scale: 55 }
      ];

      benchmarkDefinitions.forEach(benchmark => {
        const value = specs[benchmark.key];
        const available = value !== null && value !== undefined;
        const card = document.createElement("div");
        card.className = `spec-benchmark-card${available ? "" : " is-unavailable"}`;
        const bar = available
          ? `<div class="spec-benchmark-bar-track"><div class="spec-benchmark-bar-fill ${benchmark.accent || ""}" style="width: ${Math.min(100, Math.max(10, Math.round((value / benchmark.scale) * 100)))}%;"></div></div>`
          : "";
        card.innerHTML = `
          <span class="spec-benchmark-label">${benchmark.label}</span>
          <div class="spec-benchmark-value-group">
            <span class="spec-benchmark-num">${available ? (typeof value === "number" ? value.toLocaleString() : value) : "Data unavailable"}</span>
            <span class="spec-benchmark-unit">${available ? benchmark.unit : ""}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="spec-benchmark-secondary">${available ? benchmark.note : "No exact value is recorded for this vehicle."}</div>
          ${bar}
        `;
        specBenchmarksGrid.appendChild(card);
      });
    }

    // 2. Powertrain & Mechanical Architecture
    if (specPowertrainBlock && specPowertrainGrid) {
      specPowertrainGrid.innerHTML = "";
      const powertrainAttrs = [
        { label: "Engine Configuration", val: specs.engine },
        { label: "Drive Configuration", val: specs.drivetrain },
        { label: "Body Architecture", val: specs.body_type }
      ];

      if (specs.displacement_cc) {
        powertrainAttrs.push({ label: "Displacement", val: `${specs.displacement_cc.toLocaleString()} cc (${(specs.displacement_cc / 1000).toFixed(1)}L)` });
      }
      if (specs.cylinders) {
        powertrainAttrs.push({ label: "Cylinders", val: `${specs.cylinders} Cylinders` });
      }
      if (specs.fuel_type) {
        powertrainAttrs.push({ label: "Fuel System", val: specs.fuel_type });
      }
      if (specs.transmission) {
        powertrainAttrs.push({ label: "Transmission", val: specs.transmission });
      }

      specPowertrainBlock.style.display = "block";
      powertrainAttrs.forEach(attr => {
        const item = document.createElement("div");
        const available = attr.val !== null && attr.val !== undefined;
        item.className = `spec-attr-item${available ? "" : " is-unavailable"}`;
        item.innerHTML = `
          <span class="spec-attr-label">${attr.label}</span>
          <span class="spec-attr-value">${available ? attr.val : "Data unavailable"}</span>
        `;
        specPowertrainGrid.appendChild(item);
      });
    }

    // 3. Physical Architecture & Stance Dimensions
    if (specDimensionsBlock && specDimensionsGrid) {
      specDimensionsGrid.innerHTML = "";
      if (specStanceBars) specStanceBars.innerHTML = "";
      const dims = [];

      if (specs.length_mm) {
        dims.push({ label: "Overall Length", mm: specs.length_mm, inch: specs.length_in });
      }
      if (specs.wheelbase_mm) {
        dims.push({ label: "Wheelbase", mm: specs.wheelbase_mm, inch: specs.wheelbase_in });
      }
      if (specs.width_mm) {
        dims.push({ label: "Overall Width", mm: specs.width_mm, inch: specs.width_in });
      }
      if (specs.height_mm) {
        dims.push({ label: "Overall Height", mm: specs.height_mm, inch: specs.height_in });
      }

      const dimensionDefinitions = [
        { label: "Overall Length", key: "length_mm", inchKey: "length_in" },
        { label: "Wheelbase", key: "wheelbase_mm", inchKey: "wheelbase_in" },
        { label: "Overall Width", key: "width_mm", inchKey: "width_in" },
        { label: "Overall Height", key: "height_mm", inchKey: "height_in" }
      ];

      specDimensionsBlock.style.display = "block";
      dimensionDefinitions.forEach(dimension => {
        const millimetres = specs[dimension.key];
        const available = millimetres !== null && millimetres !== undefined;
        const card = document.createElement("div");
        card.className = `spec-dim-card${available ? "" : " is-unavailable"}`;
        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="spec-dim-label">${dimension.label}</div>
          <div class="spec-dim-primary">${available ? `${millimetres.toLocaleString()} mm` : "Data unavailable"}</div>
          <div class="spec-dim-secondary">${available && specs[dimension.inchKey] ? `${specs[dimension.inchKey]} in` : ""}</div>
        `;
        specDimensionsGrid.appendChild(card);
      });

      if (dims.length > 0) {
        // Stance relative bar graph
        if (specStanceBars) {
          specStanceBars.innerHTML = "";
          const maxDim = 5400; // standard reference baseline (mm)
          dims.forEach(d => {
            const pct = Math.min(100, Math.max(12, Math.round((d.mm / maxDim) * 100)));
            const row = document.createElement("div");
            row.className = "spec-stance-row";
            row.innerHTML = `
              <span class="spec-stance-name">${d.label.replace("Overall ", "")}</span>
              <div class="spec-stance-track">
                <div class="spec-stance-fill" style="width: ${pct}%;"></div>
              </div>
              <span class="spec-stance-num">${d.mm.toLocaleString()} mm</span>
            `;
            specStanceBars.appendChild(row);
          });
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function renderSpecComparison(carsList, activeCar) {
    if (!specComparisonTable) return;
    specComparisonTable.innerHTML = "";

    const maxHp = Math.max(...carsList.map(c => {
      const s = getCarSpecs(c);
      return (s && s.horsepower) ? s.horsepower : 0;
    }), 400);

    const thead = document.createElement("thead");
    thead.innerHTML = `
      <tr>
        <th>Vehicle Specimen</th>
        <th>Horsepower</th>
        <th>Curb Weight</th>
        <th>Fuel Economy</th>
        <th>Drivetrain</th>
        <th>Dimensions (L &times; W &times; H)</th>
      </tr>
    `;
    specComparisonTable.appendChild(thead);

    const tbody = document.createElement("tbody");
    carsList.forEach(car => {
      const s = getCarSpecs(car);
      const isSelected = activeCar && car["Car name"] === activeCar["Car name"];
      const tr = document.createElement("tr");
      if (isSelected) tr.className = "is-selected";

      const hpVal = (s && s.horsepower) ? `${s.horsepower} HP` : "&mdash;";
      const hpPct = (s && s.horsepower) ? Math.min(100, Math.round((s.horsepower / maxHp) * 100)) : 0;
      const wtVal = (s && s.weight_kg) ? `${s.weight_kg.toLocaleString()} kg` : "&mdash;";
      const mpgVal = (s && s.mpg) ? `${s.mpg} MPG` : "&mdash;";
      const driveVal = (s && s.drivetrain) ? s.drivetrain : (s && s.body_type ? s.body_type : "&mdash;");
      
      let dimVal = "&mdash;";
      if (s && s.length_mm && s.width_mm && s.height_mm) {
        dimVal = `${s.length_mm} &times; ${s.width_mm} &times; ${s.height_mm} mm`;
      } else if (s && s.length_mm) {
        dimVal = `${s.length_mm} mm length`;
      }

      tr.innerHTML = `
        <td>
          <div class="spec-comp-car-cell">
            <img src="${car["Image filename"] || ""}" alt="${car["Car name"]}" class="spec-comp-thumb" />
            <div>
              <div class="spec-comp-name">${car["Car name"]}</div>
              <div class="spec-comp-gen">${car["Exact model generation"] || car["Vehicle category"] || ""}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </td>
        <td class="spec-comp-bar-cell">
          <div class="spec-comp-val">${hpVal}</div>
          ${s && s.horsepower ? `
            <div class="spec-comp-mini-track">
              <div class="spec-comp-mini-fill" style="width: ${hpPct}%;"></div>
            </div>
          ` : ""}
        </td>
        <td>${wtVal}</td>
        <td>${mpgVal}</td>
        <td>${driveVal}</td>
        <td>${dimVal}</td>
      </tr>
      `;

      tr.addEventListener("click", () => {
        selectCar(car, carsList);
        setSpecViewMode("dossier");
      });

      tbody.appendChild(tr);
    });
    specComparisonTable.appendChild(tbody);
  }

  function setSpecViewMode(mode) {
    currentSpecViewMode = mode;
    if (btnViewDossier) btnViewDossier.classList.toggle("is-active", mode === "dossier");
    if (btnViewComparison) btnViewComparison.classList.toggle("is-active", mode === "comparison");

    if (mode === "dossier") {
      if (specSingleDossier) {
        specSingleDossier.classList.remove("is-hidden");
        specSingleDossier.classList.add("is-active");
      }
      if (specComparisonPanel) {
        specComparisonPanel.classList.remove("is-active");
        specComparisonPanel.classList.add("is-hidden");
      }
      if (activeSelectedCar) {
        renderSpecDossier(activeSelectedCar);
      }
    } else {
      if (specSingleDossier) {
        specSingleDossier.classList.remove("is-active");
        specSingleDossier.classList.add("is-hidden");
      }
      if (specComparisonPanel) {
        specComparisonPanel.classList.remove("is-hidden");
        specComparisonPanel.classList.add("is-active");
      }
      renderSpecComparison(currentVisibleCars, activeSelectedCar);
    }
  }

  function renderCarsGrid(carsList, year, scopeName, availableYears) {
    if (!modelsGrid) return;
    modelsGrid.innerHTML = "";

    if (carsList.length === 0) {
      if (automotiveDataStage) automotiveDataStage.classList.add("is-hidden");
      if (crumbCarSep) crumbCarSep.style.display = "none";
      if (crumbCar) crumbCar.style.display = "none";
      activeSelectedCar = null;

      const prevYears = availableYears.filter(y => y < year);
      const prevYear = prevYears.length > 0 ? prevYears[prevYears.length - 1] : null;
      const nextYears = availableYears.filter(y => y > year);
      const nextYear = nextYears.length > 0 ? nextYears[0] : null;

      const emptyCard = document.createElement("div");
      emptyCard.className = "timeline-empty-card";
      emptyCard.innerHTML = `
        <div class="timeline-empty-tag">Production Hiatus</div>
        <h3 class="timeline-empty-title">No specimens in archive for ${year}</h3>
        <p class="timeline-empty-desc">
          The historical collection contains no surviving models manufactured by <strong>${scopeName}</strong> during ${year}.
        </p>
```
