```{=html}
        <div class="timeline-empty-nav">
          ${prevYear ? `<button type="button" class="btn-jump-year" data-year="${prevYear}">&larr; Advance backward to ${prevYear}</button>` : ""}
          ${nextYear ? `<button type="button" class="btn-jump-year" data-year="${nextYear}">Advance forward to ${nextYear} &rarr;</button>` : ""}
          <button type="button" class="btn-jump-year" data-year="all">View all eras</button>
        </div>
      `;

      emptyCard.querySelectorAll(".btn-jump-year").forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
          const target = btn.dataset.year;
          if (target === "all") {
            selectTimelineYear(null);
          } else {
            selectTimelineYear(parseInt(target, 10));
          }
        });
      });

      modelsGrid.appendChild(emptyCard);
      return;
    }

    const sortedCars = [...carsList].filter(c => parseInt(c["Model year"] || 0, 10) >= 1970).sort((a, b) => parseInt(a["Model year"] || 0, 10) - parseInt(b["Model year"] || 0, 10));
    currentVisibleCars = sortedCars;

    sortedCars.forEach(car => {
      const card = document.createElement("div");
      card.className = "car-model-card";
      card.dataset.carName = car["Car name"];

      const imgSrc = car["Image filename"] || "";
      const carName = car["Car name"] || `${car["Model year"]} ${car["Manufacturer"] || scopeName}`;
      const carYear = car["Model year"] || "";
      const category = car["Vehicle category"] || car["Decade"] || "Specimen";
      const generation = car["Exact model generation"] || car["Decade"] || "";
      const source = car["Image source"] || "Automotive Archive";

      card.innerHTML = `
        <div class="car-image-frame">
          <img src="${imgSrc}" alt="${carName}" class="car-specimen-img" loading="lazy" />
          <div class="car-pills-overlay">
            <span class="car-year-pill">${carYear}</span>
            <span class="car-cat-pill">${category}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="car-details-body">
          <h4 class="car-model-name">${carName}</h4>
          <div class="car-model-gen">${generation}</div>
          <div class="car-credit-line">Source: ${source}</div>
        </div>
        <span class="car-selected-badge">Selected</span>
      `;

      card.addEventListener("click", () => {
        selectCar(car, sortedCars);
      });

      modelsGrid.appendChild(card);
    });

    // Auto-select car: keep current if still in visible set, else select first
    const stillVisible = activeSelectedCar && sortedCars.find(c => c["Car name"] === activeSelectedCar["Car name"]);
    if (stillVisible) {
      selectCar(stillVisible, sortedCars);
    } else {
      selectCar(sortedCars[0], sortedCars);
    }
  }

  function selectManufacturer(mfg) {
    window.selectedManufacturer = mfg;
    currentNavigationLevel = "manufacturer";

    // Update navigation controls
    backNavLabel.textContent = `Return to ${activeCountryData ? activeCountryData.name : 'country'}`;
    crumbCountry.classList.remove("is-current");
    crumbMfgSep.style.display = "inline";
    crumbMfg.style.display = "inline";
    crumbMfg.textContent = mfg.name;
    if (crumbYearSep) crumbYearSep.style.display = "none";
    if (crumbYear) crumbYear.style.display = "none";
    if (crumbCarSep) crumbCarSep.style.display = "none";
    if (crumbCar) crumbCar.style.display = "none";
    activeSelectedCar = null;

    populateManufacturerModels(mfg);

    // Smooth transition from Automakers to Models
    automakersPanel.style.opacity = "0";
    setTimeout(() => {
      automakersPanel.classList.remove("is-active");
      automakersPanel.classList.add("is-hidden");

      modelsPanel.classList.remove("is-hidden");
      modelsPanel.classList.add("is-active");
      modelsPanel.style.opacity = "0";

      // Scroll smoothly to content space
      document.querySelector(".country-content-space").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });

      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        modelsPanel.style.opacity = "1";
      });
    }, 180);

    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("manufacturerSelected", { detail: mfg }));
  }

  function backToCountry() {
    window.selectedManufacturer = null;
    currentNavigationLevel = "country";

    backNavLabel.textContent = "Return to atlas";
    crumbMfgSep.style.display = "none";
    crumbMfg.style.display = "none";
    crumbCountry.classList.add("is-current");
    if (crumbYearSep) crumbYearSep.style.display = "none";
    if (crumbYear) crumbYear.style.display = "none";
    if (crumbCarSep) crumbCarSep.style.display = "none";
    if (crumbCar) crumbCar.style.display = "none";
    activeSelectedCar = null;
    if (automotiveDataStage) automotiveDataStage.classList.add("is-hidden");

    modelsPanel.style.opacity = "0";
    setTimeout(() => {
      modelsPanel.classList.remove("is-active");
      modelsPanel.classList.add("is-hidden");

      automakersPanel.classList.remove("is-hidden");
      automakersPanel.classList.add("is-active");
      automakersPanel.style.opacity = "0";

      document.querySelector(".country-content-space").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });

      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        automakersPanel.style.opacity = "1";
      });
    }, 180);
  }

  function backToWorld() {
    window.selectedManufacturer = null;
    currentNavigationLevel = "world";

    if (crumbYearSep) crumbYearSep.style.display = "none";
    if (crumbYear) crumbYear.style.display = "none";
    if (crumbCarSep) crumbCarSep.style.display = "none";
    if (crumbCar) crumbCar.style.display = "none";
    activeSelectedCar = null;
    if (automotiveDataStage) automotiveDataStage.classList.add("is-hidden");

    countryView.style.opacity = "0";
    setTimeout(() => {
      countryView.classList.remove("is-active");
      countryView.classList.add("is-hidden");

      worldView.classList.remove("is-hidden");
      worldView.classList.add("is-active");
      worldView.style.opacity = "0";
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });

      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        worldView.style.opacity = "1";
      });
    }, 200);
  }

  // Unified Back button click dispatcher
  btnBackNav.addEventListener("click", function() {
    if (currentNavigationLevel === "manufacturer") {
      backToCountry();
    } else {
      backToWorld();
    }
  });

  // Breadcrumb interactive navigations
  crumbWorld.addEventListener("click", backToWorld);
  crumbCountry.addEventListener("click", function() {
    if (currentNavigationLevel === "manufacturer") {
      backToCountry();
    }
  });
  if (crumbMfg) {
    crumbMfg.addEventListener("click", function() {
      if (activeTimelineYear !== null) {
        selectTimelineYear(null);
      }
    });
  }
  if (crumbYear) {
    crumbYear.addEventListener("click", function() {
      if (modelsGrid) {
        modelsGrid.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
      }
    });
  }
  if (crumbCar) {
    crumbCar.addEventListener("click", function() {
      if (automotiveDataStage) {
        automotiveDataStage.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
      }
    });
  }

  // View mode toggles (Specimen Dossier vs Fleet Comparison)
  if (btnViewDossier) {
    btnViewDossier.addEventListener("click", () => setSpecViewMode("dossier"));
  }
  if (btnViewComparison) {
    btnViewComparison.addEventListener("click", () => setSpecViewMode("comparison"));
  }

  // Timeline button listeners
  if (btnTimelineAll) {
    btnTimelineAll.addEventListener("click", () => selectTimelineYear(null));
  }

  if (btnTimelinePrev) {
    btnTimelinePrev.addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (availableScopeYears.length === 0) return;
      if (activeTimelineYear === null) {
        selectTimelineYear(availableScopeYears[availableScopeYears.length - 1]);
      } else {
        const idx = availableScopeYears.indexOf(activeTimelineYear);
        if (idx > 0) {
          selectTimelineYear(availableScopeYears[idx - 1]);
        }
      }
    });
  }

  if (btnTimelineNext) {
    btnTimelineNext.addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (availableScopeYears.length === 0) return;
      if (activeTimelineYear === null) {
        selectTimelineYear(availableScopeYears[0]);
      } else {
        const idx = availableScopeYears.indexOf(activeTimelineYear);
        if (idx < availableScopeYears.length - 1 && idx !== -1) {
          selectTimelineYear(availableScopeYears[idx + 1]);
        }
      }
    });
  }

  if (btnExploreTimeline) {
    btnExploreTimeline.addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (activeCountryData) {
        exploreCountryTimeline(activeCountryData);
      }
    });
  }

  if (btnScopeAllCountry) {
    btnScopeAllCountry.addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (activeCountryData) {
        exploreCountryTimeline(activeCountryData);
      }
    });
  }

  function positionTooltip(event) {
    if (!mapContainer) return;
    const rect = mapContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = event.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = event.clientY - rect.top;
    tooltip.style.left = `${x}px`;
    tooltip.style.top = `${y}px`;
  }

  // Load topology
  if (window.COUNTRIES_110M) {
    renderTopology(window.COUNTRIES_110M);
  } else {
    fetch("data/countries-110m.json")
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(data => renderTopology(data))
      .catch(err => console.error("Could not load country map data", err));
  }
})();
</script>
```
